rv.q: CRUEL INTENTIONS: THE '90S MUSICAL brings it.
The creators and Azevedo have made it into something fun, compelling, utterly decadent, and truly memorable.
Full of campy fun and standout vocalists, Cruel Intentions: The 90s Musical makes for a night to remember.

Kokandy Productions’s Chicago storefront premiere of the 1999 movie’s jukebox musical adaptation is an incredibly fun nostalgia trip that still feels at turns shocking, twisted, and touching in all the right, confusing ways.
Suffice it to say the musical version is all that and a bag of chips.
Kokandy Productions brings a welcome tonic of raunchy punchlines, '90s music, and choreography to a musical just in time for summer.

This show is certainly far from "family entertainment", but if you are into the film or the music of the era or just someone who likes to watch plays about sex ( any type), this might be just right for you.
